Houghton Lake: A Michigan Ice Fishing Day

Spend a winter day ice fishing on Houghton Lake. A local outing gives you time to enjoy the wait and the next bite beneath the ice.

About this water

The fishery source record for Houghton Lake, United States, identifies Largemouth bass, Northern pike, Smallmouth bass, Walleye, Yellow perch and Bluegill.

At Houghton Lake, ask a winter provider to connect the proposed target with its current access service. Compare a perch or bluegill outing with a pike or walleye outing using the same transport and shelter details. Confirm supplied tackle before deciding to own a complete winter setup. The fishery record does not certify ice conditions or an operator's availability. Keep the final access decision with the provider's current local check.

SHOPPING LIST

Ice fishing shopping list

  • Ice fishing rod and reel combo

    A short 24–32 in rod for jigging through a hole.

    Check price ↗

  • Ice jigs and spoons

    Small tungsten jigs for perch and panfish; spoons for walleye and trout.

    Check price ↗

  • Hand auger or auger blade

    Skip this if your guide drills the holes.

    Check price ↗

  • Ice picks

    Wear them around your neck every time you walk on ice.

    Check price ↗

  • Ice cleats

    Slip-on spikes for bare, slick ice.

    Check price ↗

  • Insulated waterproof boots

    Rated for -40 °F; you stand still for hours.

    Check price ↗

  • Bucket seat with tackle storage

    A seat, a tackle box and a fish bucket in one.

    Check price ↗

  • Skimmer scoop

    Keeps the hole clear of slush.

    Check price ↗

  • Hand and toe warmers

    Cheap and easy to keep in every pocket.

    Check price ↗
